source_quote: First, co -pilot co -work does not currently ground directly on the ontology items themselves. You have to point it specifically at the Power BI report. Second, and much more dangerously, when it generates a data answer in the text, it does not currently include report citations in its output. Oh, that is a recipe for disaster in a boardroom. It is extremely dangerous. When the AI drafts a beautifully formatted summary and boldly states revenue was up 15 % in the West Region, it does not provide a footnote or hyperlink showing exactly which table or metric it used to calculate that 15%. So it could just be making it up. Therefore, the source script is adamant. The human operator must manually verify every single generated number against the source report before they ever distribute that document.
